entities.summary: Kirsten Simms is an American college ice hockey forward for the University of Wisconsin of the National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA) and member of the United States women's national ice hockey team. She was named Most Outstanding Player at the 2025 NCAA tournament after scoring two dramatic goals—a game-tying penalty shot with 18 seconds remaining in regulation and the overtime winner—to lead Wisconsin to their eighth national championship.
